concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-004 (measure total training time per prompt) is not explicitly addressed in the Phase 3 description or any other phase. The plan lists SC‑001‑006 for Phase 3 but does not state that training‑time metrics will be recorded.
Success Criterion SC-005 (measure peak memory usage) is absent from the detailed tasks. Although SC‑001‑006 are listed, no concrete step mentions memory‑usage profiling.

Success Criterion SC-006 (Human‑Eval Proxy Score must be ≥ 0.2 points higher for AntiSD) is not reflected in the analysis tasks. The plan mentions computing the proxy score but does not specify testing against the 0.2‑point threshold.
